subject: Drawing software won't get past install setup
body: Trying to put the approved drawing package on my work laptop through Company Portal. I selected Install yesterday afternoon and it is still showing Preparing this morning. I've rebooted and tried again but nothing changes. There isn't an app shortcut and I can't open it. A colleague had no trouble installing it on these laptops previously.

subject: Update restart message won't go away
body: Is anyone else getting the restart reminder repeatedly after Monday's company update? I've let my laptop restart several times now, but it asks again for that same patch once I'm back in. Programs seem fine otherwise. The reminder popped up while I was sharing my screen today. It never used to do this before that update.

subject: Can't reach apps from SSO dashboard
body: I can get into the application dashboard, but every tile I select ends up at an error saying the authentication service isn't available right now. Tried a second browser in case it was my browser settings, same result. These links all worked for me yesterday; now I can't access any of my normal apps through there.

subject: Missing work laptop — replacement allocation
body: Reporting this for a teammate whose work laptop has gone missing, possibly on the train home. They've checked with lost property without success. We looked in the asset portal to request another laptop assigned to them, but couldn't find a way to do it. Can you arrange a replacement under their name? They need a machine for tomorrow's shift.

subject: Laptop rebuild keeps returning to country selection
body: I'm at the desk with the laptop IT started rebuilding for my colleague. It was supposed to be ready yesterday. Each time we choose the region during setup, the machine reboots and brings us straight back to that question. It's done several rounds now and never reaches the desktop. We've kept the power connected as instructed. Could someone finish the rebuild? We can't work on it like this.

subject: Management check-in never ends
body: Company Portal on my laptop has been spinning on the sync status since yesterday. Normally it's done almost straight away. I restarted the laptop this morning and tried syncing again, but it just stays in progress. The approved update I'm waiting for hasn't moved out of its waiting status either. Can you look at the management connection?

subject: Shared drive access knocks out VPN
body: Working from home today. The VPN signs in fine and stays connected until I try opening a document from the shared drive, then the VPN disconnects completely. I can open documents saved on the laptop without any trouble. Rebooting made no difference. This same laptop and home internet were fine yesterday.

subject: Mac disk unlock rejecting my login
body: I'm stuck at the FileVault unlock screen on my work Mac. The login I normally use to unlock the disk is being rejected now, so I can't get through to start working. Can someone help restore access?

subject: Unexpected management registration window
body: I'm trying to get my laptop set up with company management, but a window appeared while I was using the browser asking for an admin password to enrol it. It doesn't match the Company Portal instructions I was sent. I've left it untouched rather than type a password into it. Could you check whether it's legitimate and help me get the laptop registered the proper way?

subject: Wireless failing certificate check this morning
body: My work laptop won't join the office wireless today, although it connected yesterday. The error mentions EAP failing because it can't validate the server certificate. I also see another wireless network with a very similar office name; joining that asks for a certificate installation and my company credentials. I stopped there. I'm using a cable at another desk for now and that works. Please check before we try that other network.

subject: Can't finish booking a security appointment
body: Trying to arrange a security consultation for our project. I can pick a slot and fill everything in, but submitting the booking leaves me looking at an empty screen. Nothing shows in my appointments afterwards. A colleague checked from their computer too and couldn't complete it either. We need a slot for the design discussion.

subject: Password entered on suspicious Security page
body: Reporting for a teammate who followed a message asking them to verify their account for Security. They typed their work password into the linked page, then realised it didn't look like our login. Could someone urgently help secure their account and investigate the message? We also tried attaching a picture of it to the security report, but the attachment never finishes uploading. The loading indicator just runs. Please don't let the missing attachment delay the account response.

subject: Internal pages time out with GlobalProtect on
body: Working remotely this morning and GlobalProtect shows an active connection, but I can't reach any internal sites. Public websites are fine. Restarted the VPN session and then the laptop, no difference. This same setup was fine yesterday. Is something wrong on the VPN side?

subject: Small meeting room connection unreliable
body: We've had to move our call out of the small meeting room because the wireless connection keeps cutting out. It happened on everyone's laptop, not just mine. Back at our desks the connection stays up. This only started today as far as we can tell. Please have a look before we use that room again this afternoon.

subject: Assessment download missing the filled-in responses
body: I'm doing the handover for Security's assessments and the worksheet downloads are unusable. The column titles are there but all the response cells are empty, even though I can still read the completed answers online. Checked another finished assessment and got the same result. We had populated downloads last week. Can you get the export working again rather than us having to copy the answers manually?

subject: Workshop handout links to exposed laptop recovery key
body: While checking the workshop material I noticed the shared notes include a BitLocker key for a laptop. The notes open without signing in, and their link is printed in the handout distributed at the public event. Someone has already tried to stop further sharing, but that won't tell us who may have taken a copy. Please treat the recovery key as exposed and advise what needs doing. I haven't included the key in this ticket.

subject: Security review response button won't enable
body: I'm helping with the questions on our security review. We can type the response in the tracker, but there's no way to submit it: the save control remains disabled. All mandatory boxes have values. Reloading the review and replacing the text didn't help. Replies were saving normally until yesterday, and Security is waiting on this one.

subject: Shared stock file crashes Excel for us
body: Neither of us can get into the stock spreadsheet today. As soon as we try opening that file, Excel disappears entirely without an error message. I tested a couple of unrelated workbooks and those are fine. The stock file was usable on Friday. We're stuck recording today's changes elsewhere until this is sorted.

subject: Sent back to Okta login repeatedly
body: I can't get past Okta this morning. After I sign in it returns me to the login screen again instead of letting me through. I was able to get in yesterday.

subject: Can't move my loan laptop return date
body: The asset site still lists the borrowed laptop against my account, but extending the borrowing period fails when I submit the later date. It says "Unable to save loan record" and gives AssetLoanValidationException with "current assignment could not be loaded", under ExtendLoan. Switching browsers didn't change anything. I've extended this loan successfully before. Could you fix the record so I can keep the laptop for the extra days?

subject: Can't get past equipment choice on laptop return
body: I'm arranging to hand back my assigned laptop through the returns portal. It shows up in the equipment list and I can pick it, but moving to the following step clears it out. Then the form complains that I haven't chosen anything. Tried starting the request again with the same result. I still have the machine pending the return booking.

subject: 365 sign-in times out after phone approval
body: Anyone able to check Microsoft 365 authentication? My phone receives the prompt for the login I'm doing and accepts my approval, but the browser on my computer never moves on. It sits there expecting a response until it times out. I've retried in a fresh browser window. Was able to get in earlier today.

subject: Search results stop at today's email
body: I'm trying to find an order confirmation from last month in Outlook. Search returns today's emails only, even for a sender I have years of correspondence with. I can open the older confirmation by browsing the folder, so the mail is there. Changing search terms and reopening Outlook hasn't helped. This only started today.

subject: Blank downloads from Asana
body: Could someone look at the Asana export function? The download completes but there's nothing inside the resulting file. I've checked two populated projects and both do it. We got usable exports yesterday. We need these for the review documents, so this is blocking us. Also, a less urgent admin request: our Planning team should be called Delivery Planning.

subject: Unsure about password page during laptop setup
body: Could IT get this laptop onto the standard company build? On startup it opens a web page asking for my work password, supposedly to complete the corporate installation. It doesn't resemble the setup process I've seen before, so I've left the password blank and stopped there. Please check it and finish whatever managed setup is required.

subject: VPN app disappears when launched
body: Working from home and can't start GlobalProtect. When I launch it I briefly see its icon, then it's gone before any connection controls appear. It was opening fine yesterday. I've rebooted the laptop but that hasn't changed anything. Websites load normally; it's the work shared folders I can't get to without the VPN.

subject: Unexpected replies going out from my mailbox
body: People are asking about a document link they've received as a reply from me today. I haven't written or sent those replies, and Outlook appeared to be sending things while I wasn't touching it. Emails I actually need to send are now stuck in the Outbox. I've exited Outlook, but please investigate whether somebody else has access to my account.

subject: Visitor wireless can access stored scanner forms
body: We found that connecting to the guest Wi-Fi lets you browse the scanner's storage interface and view completed visitor paperwork. Could you restrict that page to the records team through the network access rules? Scanning itself isn't broken, and we don't want anyone's existing printing access removed. It's the saved documents that need protecting.

subject: Miro licence admin page won't load
body: Trying to check how many Miro seats we have available, but the seat administration screen stays on its loading indicator indefinitely. The rest of the workspace opens without trouble. Reloading and switching browsers made no difference. I could access this screen yesterday; today I can't get the seat details at all.

subject: New desktop keeps repeating Windows installation
body: I'm helping a colleague get their replacement desktop running. It powers on and starts installing Windows, gets partway through, then reboots straight back into the installation from the beginning. We've watched it repeat several times without ever getting to the welcome screen. The network lead is connected as instructed and we haven't altered any setup options. This was supplied as a prepared machine. Can someone get the installation completed so they can start work?

subject: Can't get past gateway selection in GlobalProtect
body: Trying to work remotely this morning. After I pick the gateway, GlobalProtect sits there until it fails, saying it can't reach the network or get a response from the gateway. Browsing works normally. Rebooting made no difference and I was able to connect yesterday.

subject: Reporting area in Zoom admin not opening
body: Is anyone else unable to view reports in the Zoom admin portal today? I can sign in but can't get the reports to load. Need to pull some figures for the team.

subject: Handbook link giving security warning
body: I'm helping with induction and nobody at our table can open handbook.example.com. The browser says its certificate is out of date, with NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID underneath. My laptop clock is right and another colleague gets the same warning. We could access it yesterday. Could you get this checked?

subject: Nothing coming out of reception printer
body: The shared network printer at reception hasn't produced anything this morning. Several of us have sent documents from different computers and none have printed. Could someone take a look? It's not just my machine.

subject: Can't access my second drive
body: My extra work drive is showing a padlock today. It's BitLocker encrypted but usually opens by itself after I log in. If I select the unlock option, the dialog disappears and the drive is still inaccessible. I've rebooted without any change. All the files I need for this morning are on it.

My VPN connects but then drops while I'm working, and I've had to reconnect several times today. Yesterday I stayed connected all afternoon without this happening. Can you check what's causing the interruptions?

subject: Protection still suspended following firmware work
body: The firmware maintenance on my laptop has finished, so I'm trying to turn BitLocker protection back on. Clicking Resume shows activity briefly but leaves it suspended. A reboot didn't change anything. Everything else on the laptop works, and this step worked after our last update.

subject: Default icon change gets undone in Notion
body: I'm an admin for our Notion workspace. Today I can't set a different default page icon: it looks like it's saving, then reports a failure and restores the previous one. Tried several choices with the same outcome. I can still update other workspace settings. Could you check the icon setting specifically?

subject: Laptop security won't run, strange update prompts
body: Jamf is flagging my work laptop as noncompliant today and I can't launch the security agent. It was healthy yesterday. An unfamiliar application is also throwing up messages asking me to switch off company-managed protection before it can finish updating. I didn't install it and haven't followed those instructions. Please investigate and restore the protection.
